items.title: Elanor Moss – “Fixer”
items.summary: Horns — they can be so melancholy. Especially so on Elanor Moss' heartbreaking new The Knife, The Needle single "Fixer." If they're not melancholy enough for you, here's a lyric: "Somewhere, deep down/ I'm afraid that if you show me the knife/ I might use it on you, babe." Ouch. The post Elanor Moss – “Fixer” appeared first on Stereogum.

items.title: Smidley – “Love In Every Direction”
items.summary: Last year, Foxing announced an indefinite hiatus and played their goodbye show. Last month, frontman Conor Murphy revived his old solo side project Smidley and announced the new album Murphy Horse. Lucy Dacus appeared on lead single "Capstone," and now Murphy's got another new song. The post Smidley – “Love In Every Direction” appeared first on Stereogum.

items.title: THAO Announces New Album Show Me: Hear “Sick Of The Times” (Feat. Tune-Yards & The Linda Lindas)
items.summary: THAO has slowly been making her return. After putting Thao & The Get Down Stay Down to rest in 2021, she released the song "Ambition" the following year under the name THAO, followed by "Fossils" just last month. Now, she's announcing a new album called Show Me, co-produced with Merrill Garbus and Nate Brenner of Tune-Yards.
